name: codex-chat
title: Codex Chat
description: Chat with Codex from Raycast using your ChatGPT/Codex sign-in instead of API keys.
author: anezium

commands.name: chat
commands.title: Chat
commands.subtitle: Codex
commands.description: Browse Codex discussions, continue a topic, or start a new one.

commands.name: new-chat
commands.title: New Chat
commands.subtitle: Codex
commands.description: Start a Codex chat directly from Raycast.

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask
commands.subtitle: Codex Fast
commands.description: Ask Codex immediately with the fast preset.

commands.name: codex-status
commands.title: Codex Status
commands.subtitle: Codex
commands.description: Check Codex login status and start ChatGPT OAuth sign-in.

preferences.name: codexRuntime
preferences.title: Codex Runtime
preferences.description: Choose which Codex binary Raycast should use.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Custom Codex CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to a Codex CLI binary. Used when Runtime is Custom; Auto also honors this for existing overrides.

preferences.name: serviceTier
preferences.title: Codex Speed
preferences.description: Service tier used for Codex turns. Fast maps to Codex priority mode and may increase usage.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Model used for new chats and turns unless overridden in the message form.

preferences.name: defaultEffort
preferences.title: Default Thinking Effort
preferences.description: Reasoning effort used for turns unless overridden in the message form.

preferences.name: defaultCwd
preferences.title: Default Working Directory
preferences.description: Optional default working directory for Codex chats.

preferences.name: defaultSandbox
preferences.title: Default Sandbox
preferences.description: Sandbox policy used for Codex threads started or resumed from Raycast. Use Codex Config keeps your ~/.codex/config.toml setting.

preferences.name: defaultApprovalPolicy
preferences.title: Default Approval Policy
preferences.description: Approval policy for Codex threads. Use Codex Config keeps your ~/.codex/config.toml setting.

preferences.name: defaultSubagents
preferences.title: Subagents
preferences.description: Ask Codex to use subagents by default when starting or sending a message.
preferences.label: Ask Codex to spin up subagents by default

preferences.name: fastModel
preferences.title: Ask Model
preferences.description: Model used by the Ask command.

preferences.name: fastEffort
preferences.title: Ask Thinking Effort
preferences.description: Reasoning effort used by the Ask command.

preferences.name: fastSubagents
preferences.title: Ask Subagents
preferences.description: Ask Codex to use subagents when running Ask.
preferences.label: Ask Codex to spin up subagents in Ask
